node: Tax-credit and infrastructure-spending implementation: clean electricity, domestic manufacturing, grid, nuclear, storage, transmission, and project finance
summary: Expanded the node universe toward public companies that sit near implementation chokepoints: grid construction labor, high-voltage equipment, electrical distribution equipment, utility T&D components, and domestic-content solar balance-of-system supply. The strongest candidates are not generic clean-energy owners; they are firms whose products or services can determine whether tax-credit-eligible projects reach interconnection, domestic-content compliance, and final construction.
